verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own programmatic surface: an 'Otter API & Webhooks' tier, a Public API for custom integrations, and an MCP server. This implies the service can be driven without the UI, but the pack has no CLI, no headless-run docs and no CI guidance. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or headless invocation mode, API reference detail showing transcription and upload can be triggered programmatically, CI/pipeline usage examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API: Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms, unlocking advanced AI meeting agent workflows.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
